read.thesis: AWS grew 39.3% to a $184B run rate with $578B backlog and 38.7% margin, but Q3 capex of $75.9B and a 2026 capex of about $220B with more in 2027 keep the capital cycle expanding.

utilisation.quote: Overall demand for AWS capacity remains exceptionally strong.

capex.quote: We still expect 2026 cash CapEx of approximately $220 billion, the majority for AWS, and expect to spend meaningfully more in 2027

triggers.label: AWS growth 39.3%, backlog $578B
triggers.quote: AWS grew 39.3% year-over-year, accelerating for the sixth straight quarter, our fastest growth in nearly five years. Backlog is $578 billion

triggers.label: 2027 capex to rise meaningfully
triggers.quote: expect to spend meaningfully more in 2027 with a clear line of sight to attractive financial returns

triggers.label: Q4 operating income $28.5-33.5B
triggers.quote: Q4 operating income is expected to be between $28.5 billion and $33.5 billion.

guidance.quote: AWS can grow north of 40% in each of 2027 and in 2028
We still expect 2026 cash CapEx of approximately $220 billion
Q4 net sales are expected to be between $240 billion and $247 billion.
Q4 operating income is expected to be between $28.5 billion and $33.5 billion.
We expect year-over-year growth will return to the high teens in Q4.

red_flags.label: Operating margin hit by AI mix and component costs
red_flags.quote: the outsized growth of AI puts margin pressure on the business as a whole because the margins are lower there

red_flags.label: Fuel and line-haul cost inflation rising into Q4
red_flags.quote: it is higher in Q4 than it was in Q3

evasions.quote: We are not guiding at all on our margin for AWS

evasions.topic: Q/Q AWS growth slowdown and Q4 capacity adds
evasions.quote: The amount that we add every quarter is not equal.
